subject.title: fix(plugins): enforce manifest kinds for exclusive slots

question: Should OpenClaw formally treat all manifest `kind` values other than `memory` and `context-engine` as unsupported metadata that is discarded at parse time?
rationale: This patch deliberately narrows acceptance at the canonical manifest boundary. Tests and packaged CLI proof show the proposed behavior, but the compatibility boundary is a maintainer-owned product and upgrade decision.

options.title: Confirm the closed two-kind contract
options.body: Accept normalization to the two documented values, then rebase and merge after the current-head checks remain green.

options.title: Preserve a documented legacy kind
options.body: If a supported shipped plugin requires another kind, define that contract explicitly and revise the parser, tests, and migration guidance before merge.
